parameters.name: basehead
parameters.description: compare two refs as `base...head` (or `base..head`); refs may be branches, tags, full or short SHAs (including branch names that contain slashes), optionally with a `^` or `~N` revision suffix.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: return the raw comparison as `diff` or `patch` instead of JSON

parameters.name: verification
parameters.description: include verification for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: include a list of affected files for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')

Token.name: token
